scenario.name: r-cd-silent
scenario.description: Typed continue_delegate(mode='silent') proof. Fires a silent delegate, waits for child internal completion, then asks the parent to report the silent child token from internal context while checking no child channel delivery occurred.

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the dispatching sessions.send turn that asks the agent to call continue_delegate(mode=silent).

expectedReceipts.name: delegate-scheduled-sentinel
expectedReceipts.description: Parent emitted RCDS-SCHEDULED only after continue_delegate returned a scheduled result.

expectedReceipts.name: child-completion-observed
expectedReceipts.description: The silent delegate child completed on the internal subagent stream before the follow-up turn was sent.

expectedReceipts.name: followup-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: A later follow-up turn was accepted after the silent delegate had time to return.

expectedReceipts.name: parent-internal-context-observed
expectedReceipts.description: Parent follow-up reported the child-only SILENTCHILD token that was not included in the follow-up prompt.

expectedReceipts.name: no-channel-delivery
expectedReceipts.description: No channel-delivery event contained the child-only silent delegate token.

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID from dispatch response or task metadata for Tempo fetch/review.

review.notes: PASS-candidate requires child internal completion, delayed child-token readback from parent internal context, and no child-token channel delivery. Prefer disposable sessions for repeated runs.

liveRunSafety.notes: Live silent delegate row. Uses a child-only token plus follow-up readback to prove internal parent context without treating prompt echo as success. Serialize per target session.
